items.name: Pork Tenderloin with Dijon Cream Sauce
items.desc: Simple can be simply delicious! This juicy pork tenderloin is a delicious meat and potatoes kind of meal with a mouth-watering, creamy sauce. Stick to the basics and stick to your goals!

items.name: Philly Cheesesteak Bowl
items.desc: A customer favorite, we take a delicious spin on a decadent classic. Tender beef, onions, peppers, and melty cheese make this dish feel indulgent, even though it's quite balanced and nutritious!

items.name: Ground Chicken Curry
items.desc: Bringing you a world of flavor and nutrients, this tasty curry will leave you feeling good!

items.name: Lemon Raspberry Overnight Oats
items.desc: So fresh and bright - these are a delicious grab and go way to hit your goals!

items.name: Chicken Enchilada Soup
items.desc: Loaded with Tex Mex flavors, this creamy soup will keep you warm and cozy on the coldest days!

items.name: Pumpkin Dark Chocolate Mini Muffins
items.desc: A seasonal and tasty little treat, these pumpkin dark chocolate muffins are dairy free, gluten free and refined sugar free -BUT they're FULL of flavor and nutrition (fiber and protein WOW!).

items.desc: Simply amazing. We have absolutely PACKED this pasta with flavor and amped up the protein. It's comfort food you can feel good about eating!
